        <script><![CDATA[var CheckerTaskApproval = Class.create();
CheckerTaskApproval.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    getUserDetails: function(userID, tradeID) {

		//gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetails running begin 3508 20240903---------");
        
        var grTrade = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_trade');
        grTrade.get(tradeID);
        var owningBusiness = grTrade.owning_business; // 1) Check for the Trade’s market rather than user’s associated groups (e.g. Trade Market is: DCC HK)
        var grUser = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        grUser.get(userID);
        var userMarket = grUser.u_associated_business_markets;
		var userBand = grUser.u_user_band;

        //gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetails running begin 3508 20240903 userID---------" + userID);
		//gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetails running begin 3508 20240903 tradeID---------" + tradeID);
		//gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetails running begin 3508 20240903 owningBusiness---------" + owningBusiness);
		//gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetails running begin 3508 20240903 userMarket---------" + userMarket);
		//gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetails running begin 3508 20240903 userBand---------" + userBand);

		// Fix for defect MSSCUSTODY-3508 begin
        if (userMarket == "") {  // Check if the user has the market permission
		    gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetails - return from point 1 -  3508 20240903---------");
            return 'false';
        }
        if (userMarket.indexOf(owningBusiness) < 0) {
			gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetails - return from point 2 -  3508 20240903---------");
            return 'false';
        }
		if (userBand == "") {  // Check if the user has Band value
		    gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetails - return from point 3 -  3508 20240903---------");
			return 'false';
		}
		
		var groupTypeId = "";
        var grGroupType = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group_type');
        grGroupType.addEncodedQuery('name=' + owningBusiness);
        grGroupType.query();
        if (grGroupType.next()) {
            groupTypeId = grGroupType.sys_id;
        } else {
			gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetails - return from point 4 -  3508 20240903---------");
			return 'false';
		}
        
        // 2) Find relevant band group in that market based on logged in user’s band (e.g. DCC HK Band 4 if user is band 4)
        var grBandGroup = new GlideRecord("sys_user_group");
        grBandGroup.addEncodedQuery('u_associated_group_band=' + userBand + '^typeLIKE' + groupTypeId + '^typeLIKEb779129d1b844650ff37eb14b24bcb47^u_group_location=Onshore');
        grBandGroup.query();
        if (grBandGroup.next()) {
            if (grTrade.settlement_amount_in_usd < grBandGroup.u_usd_limit) {  // 3) Fetch the USD limit associated with the group & 4) Compare the limits
			    gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetails - return from point 5 -  3508 20240903---------");
                return 'true';
			} else {
				gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetails - return from point 6 -  3508 20240903---------");
				return 'false';
			}
        }

		gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetails - return from point 7 -  3508 20240903---------");
		return 'false';
		// Fix for defect MSSCUSTODY-3508 end

        // if (userMarket.indexOf(owningBusiness) > -1) {
        //     var grGroup = new GlideRecord("sys_user_grmember");
        //     grGroup.addEncodedQuery('group.u_group_location=Onshore^group.typeLIKEb779129d1b844650ff37eb14b24bcb47');
        //     grGroup.addQuery('user.sys_id', userID);
        //     grGroup.addQuery('group.u_associated_group_band', grUser.u_user_band);
        //     grGroup.query();
        //     if (grGroup.next()) {
        //         if (grTrade.settlement_amount_in_usd < grGroup.group.u_usd_limit) {
        //             return 'true';
        //         } else {
        //             return 'false';
        //         }
        //     }else{
		// 		return 'false'; //Added as MSSCUSTODY-3299
		// 	}
        // }
    },

		//gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetailsNominalCheck running begin 3508 20240903---------");
		
        var grTrade = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_trade');
        grTrade.get(tradeID);
        var owningBusiness = grTrade.owning_business;
        var grUser = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        grUser.get(userID);
        var userMarket = grUser.u_associated_business_markets;
		var userBand = grUser.u_user_band;

        //gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetailsNominalCheck running begin 3508 20240903 userID---------" + userID);
		//gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetailsNominalCheck running begin 3508 20240903 tradeID---------" + tradeID);

        if (userMarket.indexOf(owningBusiness) < 0) {
			gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetailsNominalCheck - return from point 2 -  3508 20240903---------");

		    gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetailsNominalCheck - return from point 3 -  3508 20240903---------");

		}
		
		var groupTypeId = "";

        } else {

        var grBandGroup = new GlideRecord("sys_user_group");
        grBandGroup.addEncodedQuery('u_associated_group_band=' + userBand + '^typeLIKE' + groupTypeId + '^typeLIKEb779129d1b844650ff37eb14b24bcb47^u_group_location=Onshore');
        grBandGroup.query();
        if (grBandGroup.next()) {
            if (grTrade.nominal_settlement_amount_in_usd < grBandGroup.u_usd_limit) {  // 3) Fetch the USD limit associated with the group & 4) Compare the limits
			    gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetailsNominalCheck - return from point 5 -  3508 20240903---------");
				return 'true';
			} else {
				gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetailsNominalCheck - return from point 6 -  3508 20240903---------");
				return 'false';
			}
        }

		gs.info("---------CheckerTaskApproval-getUserDetailsNominalCheck - return from point 7 -  3508 20240903---------");
		return 'false';
		// Fix for defect MSSCUSTODY-3508 end

        // if (userMarket.indexOf(owningBusiness) > -1) {
        //     var grGroup = new GlideRecord("sys_user_grmember");
        //     grGroup.addEncodedQuery('group.u_group_location=Onshore^group.typeLIKEb779129d1b844650ff37eb14b24bcb47');

        //             return 'true';
        //         } else {
        //             return 'false';
        //         }
        //     }else{
		// 		return 'false';   //Added as MSSCUSTODY-3299

    },


    type: 'CheckerTaskApproval'
});]]></script>
